summary: Iteration 39: Testing P0 features - Notifications (GET/DELETE endpoints, modal, links), CriarAssessoria with IBGE, Refresh button. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Notifications GET /{id} endpoint correctly returns notification details with proper auth check
Notifications DELETE /{id} endpoint correctly deletes notification and returns 404 for non-existent
NotificacoesBell component properly renders clickable links using renderMensagemComLinks function (lines 49-75)
Modal displays notification details with 'Excluir' button that calls handleExcluirNotificacao (lines 88-111)
CriarAssessoria component fetches IBGE cities via external API when estado is selected (lines 83-103)
criar-assessoria endpoint sets initial pontos: 0.5 for new assessorias (line 436 in atletas_routes.py)
Refresh button (RefreshCw) in RankingPage header calls window.location.reload() (line 363-370)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 features verified working: 1) Refresh button in header visible and functional, 2) Notifications dropdown shows list of notifications, 3) Clicking notification opens modal with details, 4) Modal has delete button that successfully deletes notification with toast feedback, 5) Notification messages can contain URLs (tested via API), 6) DELETE /api/notificacoes/{id} endpoint works correctly, 7) GET /api/notificacoes/{id} endpoint returns notification details, 8) IBGE API integration for cidade autocomplete is implemented in CriarAssessoria, 9) criar-assessoria endpoint sets initial pontos: 0.5

refresh_button.location: Header next to user name and notifications bell
refresh_button.details: Clicking refreshes the page via window.location.reload()

notifications_dropdown.details: Opens dropdown with list of notifications, each with data-testid='notificacao-item-{id}'

notification_modal.details: Opens when clicking a notification, shows full message, date, additional info, and action buttons

notification_delete.details: Delete button in modal successfully deletes notification, shows 'Notificação excluída' toast, and updates dropdown count

notification_clickable_links.details: URLs in notification messages are rendered as clickable links with external link icon (implemented in renderMensagemComLinks function)

GET_notificacoes_id.details: Returns notification details, requires auth, returns 404 for non-existent

DELETE_notificacoes_id.details: Deletes notification, requires auth, returns 404 for non-existent

criar_assessoria_ibge.details: Frontend CriarAssessoria component fetches cities from IBGE API when estado is selected. Initial pontos: 0.5 set in backend.

ibge_api_external.details: IBGE API (https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v1/localidades/estados/{uf}/municipios) is accessible and returns city list

endpoints_tested.GET /api/notificacoes: 200 OK - Returns list with nao_lidas count
endpoints_tested.DELETE /api/notificacoes/{id}: 200 OK for existing, 404 for non-existent, 401/403 without auth
endpoints_tested.POST /api/notificacoes/enviar: 200 OK - Admin can send notifications with URLs

endpoints_tested.GET /api/liga-assessorias/ranking: 200 OK - Returns assessorias with pontos_total, pontos_cadastro fields
